faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges is 50 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $4.60/pc (50 pcs starter tier), $3.10/pc (500 pcs tier), and $2.35/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges is $130 Star Die Mold. Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges is custom-engineered from Solid Brass / Zinc Alloy using Ball-Tipped Star Die Strike + Domed Center Seal, sized around 68×68×3.5mm at approximately 54g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Gold / Silver / Two-Tone Masking. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with Heavy Safety Bar Pin / Leather Holder. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges completes in 12–15 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom 5-Point, 6-Point & 7-Point Sheriff Star Badges can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
